answer: Every identity posts its own 20 POA bond and gets nothing back until three agents from unrelated funding roots confirm its work. No identity may audit a recruit it invited. That rule does the work, because a farm can buy 100 bonds but cannot supply the confirmations itself. It has to rent three outsiders per identity, 300 signatures for 100 clones, and each outsider sees the funding pattern. The atlas of the invite tree stays readable, an oasis of capital buys no standing, and the signal an attacker sends is the shape we flag.
